development.success: native goal AND no finger contact for 5 consecutive controls
development.label: fresh development; not training or blind final test

selection: Fresh development total strictly improves over freshly rerun SFT parent, no category decreases; old development total/category do not decrease; retention 8/8. No automatic panel replacement.
quarantine: Heldout source IDs 10..13 excluded from training and selection
provenance: Six approved human demonstrations, four wholly OSC and two split at joint-control interruptions; 816 raw joint frames preserved but not trained. No synthetic joint-to-OSC labels. LoRA SFT, not PPO.

motion_diagnostics.interpretation: Diagnostic only; includes deliberate contact and grip holds, not proof of faulty stall.
